title: Add Class Cancellation
description: Allow authorized administrators to cancel a class/section and notify all affected registered students.
impact_analysis: Adds section lifecycle state handling, registration blocking and notification fan-out.
decision_rationale: Required to support operational class changes without silent impact on students.

title: Student Registration Cancellation
description: Allow students to cancel their own eligible registrations and release the seat consistently.
impact_analysis: Requires authorization, registration state transition, enrollment-count correction and UI action.
decision_rationale: Provides student self-service flexibility while preserving capacity integrity.

title: Edit Class Information
description: Allow administrators to update lecturer, schedule, room, capacity, fee, semester and other permitted class attributes.
impact_analysis: Adds edit UI/API and validation while reusing existing class persistence.
decision_rationale: Keeps academic class information accurate after creation.

title: Student Self Registration
description: Provide public/unauthenticated account creation for new students with duplicate checks.
impact_analysis: Adds registration form, unique identifier validation and account persistence.
decision_rationale: Enables students to onboard without administrator-created accounts.

title: Logout and Session Termination
description: Add explicit logout handling and protected-route behavior after logout.
impact_analysis: Requires session invalidation and redirect to login.

title: Registration Confirmation Notification
description: Create an in-system notification after successful registration.
impact_analysis: Requires notification persistence and trigger from successful registration transaction.
decision_rationale: Gives immediate feedback and a persistent record of registration success.

title: Role-Based Authorization
description: Enforce role restrictions in protected API operations and UI routes.
impact_analysis: Requires centralized role checks and route/API coverage; one known HTML admin-route gap remains.
decision_rationale: Protects academic and administrative data from unauthorized access.

title: Administration Statistics
impact_analysis: Adds aggregate queries and protected statistics endpoint/UI.
decision_rationale: Supports operational monitoring and academic administration.

title: Atomic Registration Transaction
description: Ensure registration, enrollment count and confirmation notification are handled consistently.
impact_analysis: Requires transaction/rollback boundaries and automated tests for persistence and count updates.
decision_rationale: Prevents partial registration state under failures.

title: Lecturer Assignment View
description: Provide lecturers with a scoped list of their assigned teaching sections.
impact_analysis: Adds lecturer-specific query and access scope.
decision_rationale: Supports teaching operations without exposing unrelated sections.

title: Boundary Conflict Rule
description: Clarify that adjacent classes such as 08:00–10:00 and 10:00–12:00 do not overlap.
impact_analysis: Adds explicit interval boundary rule and automated test coverage.
decision_rationale: Removes ambiguity from schedule conflict validation.

title: Protect Admin HTML Route
description: Apply the same administrator authorization requirement to the admin HTML page as the admin statistics API.
impact_analysis: Current source review identifies a likely route-level authorization gap; implementation and regression test are required.
decision_rationale: Ensures UI access control is consistent with API authorization.
